Second, they are used to do protective oxygen supplying when there is fire, smoke or toxic gas. Third, there may be emergency medical situations in demand of oxygen supplying. If there were a cabin fire or there were dense smoke in the cabin, passengers and crew members should wear the PBE quickly to protect their eyes and breathing system from fire/smoke damage.
corrections.after: Different oxygen and breathing devices have different purposes. Passenger oxygen masks are used for a loss of cabin pressure. Medical oxygen may be used when needed. Crew members use protective breathing equipment for protection against smoke and harmful gases while carrying out their duties.

corrections.before: 通常需要使用供氧设备的情况有三种：第一，机舱失压时，需要紧急供氧；第二，当机舱内出现火灾、烟雾或毒气时，需要用供氧设备防护；第三，紧急医疗状况时需要供氧。机舱内失火或有浓烟时，乘客和机组人员应快速戴上呼吸保护器，保护眼睛和呼吸系统免于火/烟的伤害。
corrections.after: 不同的供氧和呼吸设备用途不同。旅客氧气面罩用于客舱失压，医疗供氧设备按需要使用。机组人员执行相关职责时使用防护呼吸设备，保护自己免受烟雾和有害气体影响。

corrections.before: Once encountering the clear air turbulence, the aircraft must descend rapidly, so I will try to keep configuration of the aircraft and instruct all cabin crew and passengers to keep belts fastened. At the same time, I would contact ATC and advise our situation and report my intentions. As long as we pilot keep calm, we will overcome the emergency safely.
corrections.after: I would follow the aircraft turbulence procedure, avoid abrupt control inputs, and ensure that passengers and cabin crew are seated with their seat belts fastened. I would report the turbulence to ATC and coordinate any necessary change of level or route.

corrections.before: 一旦遭遇晴空湍流，飞机必须迅速下降，所以我会尽量保持飞机的配置并命令机组人员和乘客系紧安全带。同时我会联系ATC并报告我的意图。只要飞行员保持冷静就可以安全处理紧急情况。
corrections.after: 我会执行本机型的颠簸程序，避免突然操纵，并确保旅客和客舱乘务员就座、系好安全带。我会向空管报告颠簸，并协调必要的高度或航路调整。

corrections.before: Yes, the flight control system used in Airbus is fly-by-wire, while the flight control system of Boeing is mechanical.
corrections.after: Flight control systems differ by aircraft type, not simply by manufacturer. Many Airbus aircraft use fly-by-wire, and Boeing aircraft such as the 777 and 787 also use fly-by-wire. The details and control laws must be compared for the specific models.

corrections.before: 有，空中客车使用电传操纵系统，波音使用机械操纵系统。
corrections.after: 飞行操纵系统的差异取决于具体机型，不能只按制造商品牌区分。许多空客飞机采用电传操纵，波音777和787等机型也采用电传操纵。具体系统和控制律应按机型比较。

corrections.before: In my opinion, Boeing 747 is much safer than Airbus 380. Boeing 747 has long been used, so the known defects have been improved, and Boeing 747 is mechanically controlled, its emergency handling can be flexible. Airbus 380 is fly-by-wire, once there is something wrong with the cable, things will be difficult to deal with, but I do believe that both Boeing 747 and Airbus 380 are outstanding aircraft.
corrections.after: I would not conclude that the Boeing 747 is safer simply because of its control system type. The A380 has segregated, redundant flight control power sources and backup systems. A meaningful safety comparison needs evidence about the specific aircraft and operating conditions, not an assumption that fly-by-wire becomes unmanageable after a wiring fault.
corrections.reason: 源答案以机械/电传架构直接断言747安全很多，且忽略A380隔离冗余及备用系统。官方架构资料可直接否定其单一线路故障推论；不改成相反的品牌安全排名。

corrections.before: 在我看来，波音747要比空中客车A380安全很多。波音747投入使用的时间更长，基本上已知的缺陷都已得到改善，而且波音747使用机械操纵系统，应急处理很灵活。但是空中客车A380使用电传操纵系统，一旦电缆出现问题会很难处理。但我坚信波音747和空中客车A380都是非常优秀的飞机。
corrections.after: 我不会仅凭操纵系统类型就断定波音747更安全。A380的飞行操纵系统具有相互隔离的冗余动力来源和备用系统。比较安全性需要具体机型和运行条件方面的证据，不能假定电传系统一旦出现线路故障就难以操纵。

corrections.before: 2015年1月29日，一架瑞安航空的波音737-800从伦敦飞往贝尔热拉克，执行FR8592次航班，在仪表气象条件下，使用NDB Y进近到贝尔热拉克的28跑道。飞机移交给塔台时下降到最低安全高度以下。进场管制员收到了最低安全高度警告，飞机的EGPWS也发出了警告。机组人员执行了复飞，飞机爬升到安全高度。然后，机组人员准备再次进近，在第一次中断进近约24分钟后，安全降落在28号跑道上。根据调查，事故发生时，飞机正在执行NDB进近，没有DME，可能没有外部视觉参考。与此同时，第一次精密进近可能是不完整或不精确的。结果，后期的修正没有让机组人员实现既定的制导模式。这导致机长混淆了飞机应该遵循的水平轨迹。这种混乱的状态使他提前下降到安全高度以下。
corrections.after: On January 29, 2015, a Ryanair Boeing 737-800 operating flight FR8592 from London to Bergerac was conducting the NDB Y approach to runway 28 at Bergerac in instrument meteorological conditions. The aircraft descended below the minimum safe altitude when it was handed over to the tower. The approach controller received a Minimum Safe Altitude Warning, and the aircraft's EGPWS also issued a warning. The crew executed a go-around and climbed to a safe altitude. The crew then prepared for another approach and landed safely on runway 28 approximately 24 minutes after discontinuing the first approach. According to the investigation, the aircraft was conducting an NDB approach without DME and probably without external visual references. Meanwhile, the initial preparation for the approach was insufficiently precise and complete. As a result, the later corrections did not enable the crew to achieve the intended guidance mode. This caused the captain to become confused about the lateral path that the aircraft should follow. In this state of confusion, he descended below the safe altitude prematurely.
corrections.reason: BEA2015-0037官方报告明确为initial approach preparation，且ILS/DME不可用、实际执行NDB Y；中文“精密进近”系误译。英文沿用既有完整中文参考的忠实翻译，仅修正该术语，中文同时保留并纠正。此两项替代前一语言提案152972两项。
